gloss: to change; to alter; to revise

definitions.gloss: to change; to alter; to modify
definitions.explanation: To replace something already decided or registered — a plan, a date, a setting, an address — with something different. The thing changed is deliberate and on the record, which is what separates {変更|へんこう}する from ordinary change verbs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{変更|へんこう}します。
⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{変更|へんこう}する⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I went through the procedure for changing my address.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天候|てんこう}→天候：03558_tenkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{変更|へんこう}させて⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: Due to the bad weather, we will be changing the departure time.

examples.japanese: ⟦パスワード→パスワード：05277_pasuwaado⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧か{月|げつ}ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{変更|へんこう}すること⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦おすすめ→おすすめ：09746_osusume⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We recommend changing your password every three months.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive — the thing being changed takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧. The passive {変更|へんこう}される is very common in announcements, where the decider is an organization: ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{変更|へんこう}されました (the venue has been changed).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{変更|へんこう}する: to change one's plans
- ⟦{日時|にちじ}→日時：00316_nichiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{変更|へんこう}する: to change the date and time
- ⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{変更|へんこう}する: to change a setting
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{変更|へんこう}する: to revise a plan
- ⟦{仕様|しよう}→仕様：00472_shiyou⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧: a change of specifications

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change — the everyday word, and the one to use for informal or physical changes
- ⟦{改|あらた}める→改める：12923_aratameru⟧: to revise; to correct — implies improving or putting right, not merely substituting
- ⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: to change (by itself) — intransitive; nothing is being changed by an agent
